still_open: MK-NW-F-035: formula needs clarification on whether the weighted average of portfolio volatility is accurate when cross-asset covariance is not computed.

formula_checks.name: primaryCarIdOf
formula_checks.why: Correctly isolates vehicles, filters out zero/missing values, ranks by balance, and breaks ties by lower ID.

formula_checks.name: earmarkedAmount
formula_checks.why: Applies account balance to the stated retirement share or falls back to the appropriate smart default.

formula_checks.name: retirementEarmarkedValue
formula_checks.why: Correctly sums the earmarked amounts across all accounts using primary vehicle and home identification.

formula_checks.name: benchmarkReturn
formula_checks.why: Properly checks user overrides (including a zero rate) before falling back to app-specified asset kind defaults.

formula_checks.name: blendedVolatility
formula_checks.why: A weighted average of individual volatilities does not account for asset correlation/covariance, which is required for true portfolio volatility.
formula_checks.should_be: Must incorporate covariance matrix or correlation coefficients among asset classes once built, or explicitly note it as an independent approximation.

formula_checks.name: benchmarkInfo
formula_checks.why: Accurately combines rate data from benchmarkReturn with metadata flags regarding custom overrides and estimate status.

formula_checks.name: blendedReturn
formula_checks.why: Calculates expected return correctly across earmarked accounts weighted by their earmarked value, with proper zero handling.

formula_checks.name: earmarkedKinds
formula_checks.why: Properly extracts distinct investment kinds from non-property accounts with positive earmarked amounts, defaulting unamed kinds to 'other'.

formula_checks.name: buildAssetsState
formula_checks.why: Handles missing balances by filtering them out, computes correct percentage shares summing to 100, and manages zero total states properly.

formula_checks.name: assetsFromOnboarding
formula_checks.why: Correctly parses onboarding responses into up to four asset accounts with specific rules for unclassified savings.

formula_checks.name: monthlyContributionsFromOnboarding
formula_checks.why: Accurately applies age-based legal limits (2026 limits: $24,500 / $32,500 / $35,750), adds Roth and investment contributions, and handles employer matching rules.

formula_checks.name: getAssetsState
formula_checks.why: Properly retrieves saved accounts and returns assetsStateFrom them or nothing if empty.

formula_checks.name: sourceWording
formula_checks.why: Accurately formats wording for linked, imported, and manual accounts, incorporating age thresholds for sync freshness.

formula_checks.name: historyCoverage
formula_checks.why: Handles history start checks, unreadable dates, fractional month coverage calculations, and proper rounding down.

formula_checks.name: uberGroupOf
formula_checks.why: Maps asset classes accurately to their three corresponding uber-groups.

formula_checks.name: uberGroupRows
formula_checks.why: Groups and sums class rows into Cash, Investments, and Personal property in the designated order.

formula_checks.name: itemizedTotal
formula_checks.why: Correctly sums itemized holdings as exact decimals while safely skipping missing values without assuming zero.

formula_checks.name: itemizeRemainder
formula_checks.why: Calculates remainder precisely as lump balance minus itemized total without introducing stray fraction artifacts.

formula_checks.name: itemizedResultTotal
formula_checks.why: Ensures itemized account totals never drop below the original lump balance when holdings exceed it.

formula_checks.name: buildItemizedAccounts
formula_checks.why: Refuses execution if any holding value is missing, builds individual asset accounts correctly, and rolls unallocated cash into a separate cash account.

formula_checks.name: correctClassOf
formula_checks.why: Properly respects user-chosen classes while applying cascading logic based on maturity dates, name evidence, and standard rules.

formula_checks.name: reclassifyAccounts
formula_checks.why: Respects user confirmations, applies class corrections without corrupting tax buckets, and evaluates holding classifications correctly.

formula_checks.name: isBond
formula_checks.why: Evaluates whether an account is a bond strictly based on its asset class (Bonds & CDs).

formula_checks.name: bondInfo
formula_checks.why: Extracts bond metrics accurately, treating unentered values as null rather than zero, and properly parsing CD purchasing origin.

formula_checks.name: annualCoupon
formula_checks.why: Multiplies face value by coupon rate correctly, returning null if either is missing.

formula_checks.name: yearsToMaturity
formula_checks.why: Calculates exact calendar anniversaries and fractional day periods correctly without time-of-day or timezone shifts.

formula_checks.name: currentYield
formula_checks.why: Divides annual coupon by statement market value, excluding accrued interest from the price denominator.

formula_checks.name: approxYTM
formula_checks.why: Handles bank CDs using stated rates, broker CDs and bonds using iterative yield-to-price matching incorporating accrued interest.

formula_checks.name: bondSummary
formula_checks.why: Aggregates counts, total values, face values, coupon sums, value-weighted average yields, and upcoming maturities correctly.

formula_checks.name: couponIncomeAnnual
formula_checks.why: Sums annual coupons across bond and CD accounts, correctly zeroing out matured bonds.
